paite: Tura kho puakgik. Tarsis long liante aw, mau tuaituai un; in himhim omlou khop leh lutna himhim om lou khpa hihsiatin a omta hi; huai lah Kittim gama kipanin a kiang ua hihlatin a om hi.
english: The burden of Tyre. Howl, you ships of Tarshish! For it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in. From the land of Kittim it is revealed to them.

paite: Tuikulha omte aw, dai sipsip un; Sidon kho sumsin tuipi-a paiten a honkiningchin sak uh.
english: Be still, you inhabitants of the coast, you whom the merchants of Sidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.

paite: Tuipi-a, Shihor chi, Nile lui buh lak, a punna hi naka, nam chih sumsinna mun ahi nak hi.
english: On great waters, the seed of the Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue. She was the market of nations.

paite: Sidon aw, zumin; tuipi kulh piin, thu a genta ngala, Nau ka vei ngei keia, ka nei ngei sam kei, tangval lah ka vak ngei sam keia, nungak leng ka khangliansak ngei sam kei hi, chiin.
english: Be ashamed, Sidon; for the sea has spoken, the stronghold of the sea, saying, “I have not travailed, nor brought forth, neither have I nourished young men, nor brought up virgins.”

paite: Thuthang Aigupta gam a tun hun chiangin Tura thuthang a nak vei mahmah ding uh.
english: When the report comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report of Tyre.

paite: Tarsish ah va hoh unla; Tuikulha omte aw, mau tuaituai un.
english: Pass over to Tarshish! Wail, you inhabitants of the coast!

paite: Hiai maw na kho kipak uh, a upata upa, a khein gamlapi-a om dinga a pi sek?
english: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days, whose feet carried her far away to travel?

paite: Lallukhu khusaktu khua Tura tungah kuan ahia hiai tung dinga sep? huailaia sumsinmite lah mi liante ahi ua, huai laia sumsinmite lah leia mi zahtakhuaite ahi ngal ua.
english: Who has planned this against Tyre, the giver of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honorable of the earth?

paite: Sepaihte TOUPAN, thupina tengteng kisaktheihna nawngkaisak ding leh, leia mi zahtakhuai tengteng muhsithuaia omsak dingin, a sep hi.
english: Yahweh of Armies has planned it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.

paite: Tarsish tanu aw, Nile lui bangin na gamah luang letin; na kawnggak na himhim lah a omta kei a.
english: Pass through your land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish. There is no restraint any more.

paite: Tuipi tungah a khut a jaka, gamte a lingsaka; TOUPAN Kanaan gam tungtangah thu a piaa, a kulhte hihse dingin.
english: He has stretched out his hand over the sea. He has shaken the kingdoms. Yahweh has ordered the destruction of Canaan’s strongholds.

paite: Huan, aman, Sidon tanu nungak aw, mi nuaisiah, nuam na sa nawn kei ding; thou inla, Kittim gamah galkahin; huailaiah leng khawlna himhim na mu tuan kei ding hi, a chi a.
english: He said, “You shall rejoice no more, you oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, pass over to Kittim. Even there you will have no rest.”

paite: Enin, Kaldaite gam; hiai mite a omta kei uh; Assuria miin gamdaia gamsate adingin a septa hi; a insangte uh a lam ua, huaia inpite a hihmang ua, in siain a bawlta.
english: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans. This people was not. The Assyrians founded it for those who dwell in the wilderness. They set up their towers. They overthrew its palaces. They made it a ruin.

paite: Tarsish long liante aw, mau tuaituai un; na kulhte uh hihsiatin a om ta hi.
english: Howl, you ships of Tarshish, for your stronghold is laid waste!

paite: Huan, huai niin hichi ahi dinga, Tura khua, kumpipa khat kum sima, kum sawm sagih sung mangngilhin a om ding; kum sawmsagih man nungin kijuak laa a gen bang un Tura kho tungah a hongtung ding.
english: It will come to pass in that day that Tyre will be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king. After the end of seventy years it will be to Tyre like in the song of the prostitute.

paite: Nang kijuak mite mangngilhsa nung kaihging la inla, kho kimah vakin, kaihging kai inla, ka tampi sa in theiha na om nawn theihna dingin.
english: Take a harp; go about the city, you prostitute that has been forgotten. Make sweet melody. Sing many songs, that you may be remembered.

paite: Huan, kum sawmsagih a man nungin hichi ahi dinga, TOUPAN Tura khua a pha dinga, huchiin huai minu a loh delhin a om nawn dinga, leitunga khovel gam tengteng lakah kijuakin a om ding.Huan, a sum muhkhiak leh a loh TOUPA adingin thil siangthou ahi ding; huailah kholkhawmin hiam, koihkhawmin hiam a om kei dinga, a sum muhkhiak TOUPA maa omte adingin ahi sin ngala, niang leh taia a nek ding uleh, puansilh thupi tak a neih theihna ding un.
english: It will happen after the end of seventy years that Yahweh will visit Tyre, and she shall return to her wages, and will play the prostitute with all the kingdoms of the world on the surface of the earth.

paite: Huan, a sum muhkhiak leh a loh TOUPA adingin thil siangthou ahi ding; huailah kholkhawmin hiam, koihkhawmin hiam a om kei dinga, a sum muhkhiak TOUPA maa omte adingin ahi sin ngala, niang leh taia a nek ding uleh, puansilh thupi tak a neih theihna ding un.
english: Her merchandise and her wages will be holiness to Yahweh. It will not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise will be for those who dwell before Yahweh, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
